Message templates match spec exactly. No technical details in messages. Deduplication by (task_id, kind) prevents duplicates. Notification failures isolated from task state. Uses existing ledger, flush, providers. Telegram untouched. 49-check offline test suite validates all requirements. Architecture preserves tick performance and provides restart safety.
